name: solidity-case-book
skills: Solidity security review from a case-book of what audits and audit contests of real protocols have reported: shares, accounting and rounding; lending, liquidations and oracles; swaps, pools and slippage; rewards and staking; access, upgrades and governance; tokens, external calls and reentrancy; bridges, messages and signatures; denial of service and limits. Each finding says who gains, who loses or what stops, and quotes the lines it rests on. Writes Foundry proofs of concept.
examples: Audit this vault before launch: what have audits of similar contracts found?
Is this liquidation path safe against a stale or manipulated price?
Review this staking contract: can rewards be claimed twice or lost?
